articles.title: The AI Agent Nobody Owns: Watch Expert Webinar On Your Newest Insider Threat
articles.summary: Right now, there is probably an AI agent running on a laptop somewhere in your network. It stores API keys and database passwords, can access your internal systems, and works without anyone watching. Nobody reviewed its access. Nobody owns it. If an employee had that much reach with that little oversight, you would call it an insider risk. So why do we still call the agent a productivity tool?

articles.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
articles.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. articles.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering

articles.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws

articles.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
articles.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters.
